definitions.explanation: A building for dwelling; one's residence.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{家|いえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a big house.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}します→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家|いえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: I want to buy a new house next year, but I don't have money right now.

notes:
{家|いえ} refers to a house (building) and home (place where one lives).

READINGS:
- {家|いえ}: house, home (standard reading)
- うち: home, my house (more colloquial, can also mean "my family/company")

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {家|いえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to go home
- {家|いえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to build a house
- {家|いえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a house
- {家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work from home

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: family
- {家事|かじ}: housework
- {家庭|かてい}: household, home

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: residence, housing (formal)
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧: one's own home (formal)
- マンション: apartment building
